_readme: The starting cast. Change any name, stat, trait id or line of dialogue here and the game picks it up on next launch - no code changes needed. Stats run 1-10. 'traits' must reference ids in traits.json. 'visual' drives the procedurally drawn portrait (scripts/ui/character_portrait.gd); every field has a safe fallback, so a typo degrades gracefully instead of crashing.

characters.name: Big Dave
characters.description: Six foot eight of confident misunderstanding. Solves every problem the same way and is undefeated at it.

success: Big Dave nods once, as if he planned that.
Big Dave did not know it would work. Big Dave is not surprised.
failure: Big Dave looks at his hands, betrayed.
Big Dave has decided the wall started it.

characters.name: The Professor
characters.description: Convicted of an insurance fraud so elegant the jury applauded. Cannot open a jar.

success: The Professor explains why it worked. At length.
"As predicted," says the Professor, who did not predict it.
failure: The Professor blames the methodology.
The Professor requests a peer review of what just happened.

characters.name: Grandma Ruth
characters.description: In for tax evasion across four decades and six identities. Brings snacks to the heist.

success: Grandma Ruth pats the guard's cheek and walks straight through.
Grandma Ruth has been doing this since before the guard was born.
failure: Grandma Ruth pretends to be confused. It does not take this time.
Grandma Ruth blames her hip and is escorted away, furious.

characters.name: Sockets
characters.description: Took down a city's parking meter network for reasons he still describes as 'principled'.

success: Sockets does not look up from the panel.
Sockets says "obviously" to nobody.
failure: Sockets insists the system is wrong, not him.
Sockets has bricked something. Possibly two somethings.

characters.name: Vinnie Salerno
characters.description: Disbarred for a conflict of interest involving himself, his client, and a boat.

success: Vinnie calls it a settlement.
Vinnie would like the record to show that worked.
failure: Vinnie files an objection. It is overruled physically.
Vinnie says the word "technically" and is ignored.

characters.name: Chad Thunderquad
characters.description: Arrested during a protein heist. Has never once skipped, and will tell you so.

success: Chad flexes at the security camera.
Chad calls it a new personal best.
failure: Chad blames his pre-workout.
Chad pulled something. Chad pulled several things.

characters.name: Fingers Malone
characters.description: Nobody has ever proven anything. Nobody has ever found their wallet, either.

success: Fingers already has whatever it was.
Fingers was never here. Fingers has receipts proving it.
failure: Fingers drops everything. Loudly. In sequence.
Fingers is caught holding three things he cannot explain.

characters.name: Silky Pete
characters.description: Sold the same timeshare to eleven people, four of whom are still grateful.

success: Silky Pete has made a new friend and a small profit.
Silky Pete never raised his voice once.
failure: Silky Pete's story develops a hole. Then several.
Silky Pete is politely asked for identification.

characters.name: Hank
characters.description: Worked here for nineteen years before the sentencing. Sees no reason to change routine.

success: Hank knew that door was like that.
Hank has opened this panel four thousand times.
failure: Hank says they changed the locks in March.
Hank mutters about budget cuts.

characters.name: Houdini Jr.
characters.description: Can escape anything except the consequences of his own marketing claims.

success: Houdini Jr. is simply no longer where he was.
Houdini Jr. bows. There is no audience.
failure: Houdini Jr. is stuck. Extremely stuck.
Houdini Jr. requests that nobody describe this later.

characters.name: Mama Kowalski
characters.description: Ran the cafeteria for a decade. Runs it still. Nobody has told the warden.

success: Mama Kowalski feeds the guard. The guard forgets the question.
Mama Kowalski has never been refused anything.
failure: Mama Kowalski is offended. The whole wing knows.
Mama Kowalski throws something nutritious.

characters.name: Dr. Nibbles
characters.description: A veterinarian who treated humans for eight years without anyone noticing or complaining.

success: Dr. Nibbles pronounces it a clean procedure.
Dr. Nibbles does not explain where the equipment came from.
failure: Dr. Nibbles says that has never happened before, which is a lie.
Dr. Nibbles asks everyone to stop looking at it.

characters.name: Bug
characters.description: Spent eleven years in the mines and considers daylight a passing fad.

success: Bug is already twelve feet into the floor.
Bug says the dirt here is good dirt.
failure: Bug has found a pipe he was not looking for.
Bug is up to his waist in something.

characters.name: Sister Agatha
characters.description: Left the order under circumstances the order declines to discuss. Still blesses people. Aggressively.

success: Sister Agatha calls it providence. It was not.
Sister Agatha forgives the guard for something he has not done yet.
failure: Sister Agatha says a word she has not said since 1987.
Sister Agatha looks upward, disappointed in management.

characters.name: Twitch
characters.description: Holds the facility record for the yard sprint. Also for the number of times caught sprinting.

success: Twitch is across the room before the sentence ends.
Twitch has done it twice to be sure.
failure: Twitch runs into the one thing in the room.
Twitch was so fast he arrived before the plan.

characters.name: Old Man Mordecai
characters.description: Has been here longer than the building's current paint. Knows which walls are lying.

success: Mordecai saw a man do that in 1974. It worked then too.
Mordecai does not celebrate. Mordecai has seen celebrations go wrong.
failure: Mordecai says this is exactly what happened to Feeney.
Mordecai sits down. He will be a moment.

characters.name: Brenda
characters.description: Certified welder, uncertified demolition enthusiast. Brought the workshop up to code by removing it.

success: Brenda steps back to admire the hole.
Brenda says that is load-bearing now, actually.
failure: Brenda has welded two things that should never have met.
Brenda set off something that was not a fire alarm.

characters.name: Rico
characters.description: Has two phones. Has always had two phones. Nobody has located either phone.

success: Rico takes a call in the middle of it.
Rico says he'll have someone handle the paperwork.
failure: Rico's contact does not pick up.
Rico has lost a phone. He still has two phones.

characters.name: Norm
characters.description: Perfectly, aggressively median in every measurable way. It is somehow his most alarming quality.

success: Norm does an adequate job and it is somehow enough.
Norm did not stand out. That was the whole plan.
failure: Norm fails in a way nobody will remember.
Norm apologises to the correct number of people.

characters.name: Gutsy Greg
characters.description: Will eat it. Whatever it is. This has been useful exactly twice and catastrophic eleven times.

success: Greg swallowed the evidence. All of it.
Greg says it was fine, actually.
failure: Greg has eaten something structural.
Greg is having a moment and needs the room.
